scope: Existing 0000–0118 records; inventory and prioritisation, not automatic scientific certification.
method: Domain candidates from existing audit; exact reviewed panel registry; quantitative chart manifest; Markdown table syntax and image-file counts are inventory only.

recommendations.action: Complete provenance and acceptance review before assigning a fully advanced status.
recommendations.reason: All element-domain cells currently require scientific acceptance; source/heading presence is only discovery evidence.

recommendations.action: Keep one canonical owner per dataset and project, using versioned references for shared data.
recommendations.reason: Peer desktop repositories have independent work in progress; a shared programme does not imply safe file-level merging.

recommendations.action: Finish Hydrogen as the reviewed publication example while expanding source-backed data batches across all applicable elements.
recommendations.reason: The 9+13 standalone-image contract is only partially populated; mature authored records govern flow rather than generic placeholders.

recommendations.action: Prioritise missing nuclear Q-value review, isotope-specific NMR, actual spectral lines and state-specific solid/phase/material measurements.
recommendations.reason: Existing nuclear and ionisation tables do not supply these distinct domains.

recommendations.action: Use source uncertainty and covariance for calculations; report unavailable uncertainty explicitly.
recommendations.reason: Derived precision and energetically possible channels must not be presented as new measurements or observed decay.

recommendations.action: Separate author hypotheses, historical material and concept art from evaluated physical data.
recommendations.reason: Cross-project conversation and image content may be useful design input without independent scientific support.

recommendations.action: Add typed shared envelopes for source, claim, state, artifact, task and acceptance evidence; validate a small round trip before broad integration.
recommendations.reason: Shared provenance and status semantics can connect projects without claiming working integration.
